goals.title: 감각적인 꽁돈 웹디자인 페이지를 만든다. 기존 outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/site 정적 사이트를...
goals.objective: 감각적인 꽁돈 웹디자인 페이지를 만든다. 기존 outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/site 정적 사이트를 https://www.nomoredesign.co.uk/의 editorial motion rhythm, black-white chapter contrast, work/media strip, large typographic hero DNA를 꽁돈 브랜드에 맞게 번역한다. 실제 프로젝트 캡처 3장을 유지하고 브라우저 QA 및 독립 visual/design review로 증명한다.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser visual happy path: node scripts/run-visual-qa.mjs --target outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/site --out outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/qa-ulw; PASS iff report.json pass=true and desktop.png shows reference-inspired word-composition hero, black work/media strip, alternating editorial chapters, and actual project screenshot showcase.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Final desktop/browser QA passed: node scripts/check-sensory-structure.mjs; node scripts/validate-design-contract.mjs outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/DESIGN.md; node scripts/run-visual-qa.mjs --target outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/site --out outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/qa-ulw. Evidence: qa-ulw/report.json pass=true, desktopOverflow=false, mobileOverflow=false, desktop.png shows word-hero, black media-reel/work-strip, alternating chapters, real screenshots. Cleanup: QA script closed Playwright browser and local server.

successCriteria.scenario: Mobile/CJK responsive edge: node scripts/run-visual-qa.mjs --target outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/site --out outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/qa-ulw-mobile; PASS iff report.json pass=true, mobile.png at 390px has no horizontal overflow, no clipped controls, project images remain inspectable, and hero word composition is compact without awkward one-syllable CJK orphan lines.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Final mobile/CJK QA passed: node scripts/run-visual-qa.mjs --target outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/site --out outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/qa-ulw-mobile. Evidence: qa-ulw-mobile/report.json pass=true, mobileOverflow=false, mobile.png reviewed after polish; mobile header is non-sticky, hero spacing improved, media cue added, body line-height improved. Cleanup: QA script closed Playwright browser and local server.

successCriteria.scenario: Independent visual/design review regression: spawn read-only visual/design reviewers with reference screenshot outputs/kkongdon-ai-brand-site/qa/reference-nomoredesign.png, actual qa-ulw screenshots, DESIGN.md, index.html, styles.css, script.js; PASS iff reviewer returns unconditional PASS/no blocking findings for reference-inspired editorial rhythm, real DOM/design-system implementation, interactions, and CJK precision.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Reviewer final message with VERDICT PASS and no blocking findings, plus fresh qa-ulw artifacts referenced
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Independent review PASS: verifier agent PASS on structural/design/QA commands; code-reviewer PASS on word-hero, data-word-cycle, media-reel, work-strip, three chapter-black sections, real images, CTA/click/hover/scroll; vision reviewer PASS on editorial word hero, black media strip, alternating chapter rhythm, non-generic Korean brand feel, mobile readability. Minor vision suggestions were applied and QA reran green.

goals.evidence: All criteria C001-C003 pass. Final QA commands passed after visual polish; reviewers returned PASS; artifacts saved under qa-ulw and qa-ulw-mobile.
